scenes.image_prompt: A female cute cartoon cat named Basbusa wearing a bright blue scarf being pulled towards a swirling magical blue vortex on an old Cairo rooftop at night, dynamic visual style.

scenes.narration: قفزت بسبوسة بسرعة شجاعة ومسكت قطعة المصباح المكسور قبل السقوط.
scenes.image_prompt: A female cute cartoon cat named Basbusa wearing a bright blue scarf jumping bravely across old wooden rooftops in Cairo holding a glowing piece of a brass lamp.

scenes.narration: ركضت بسبوسة بين السطوح القديمة، والقط زيكو يطاردها بغضب شديد.
scenes.image_prompt: A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya chasing a female cute cartoon cat wearing a bright blue scarf across Cairo rooftop domes under moonlight.

scenes.narration: وفجأة أخرجت القطعة شعاعاً ذهبياً ساحراً كشف سر المكان وأوقف زيكو.
scenes.image_prompt: A female cute cartoon cat named Basbusa wearing a bright blue scarf holding up a glowing broken lamp piece that shines a brilliant golden light beam, freezing A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya in place.

scenes.narration: انشق قاع المصباح فجأة وظهر منه وحش ظل ضخم يهدد الحارة كلها.
scenes.image_prompt: A tall ominous shadow monster rising out of dark smoke from the broken lamp piece, looming over both a female cute cartoon cat wearing a blue scarf and A large magical one-eyed cat spirit wearing a traditional Egyptian galabiya.

scenes.narration: الخطر يحيط بالمكان ولا يوجد مفر. انتظروا الجزء الرابع! وهل تنجو بسبوسة من خطر هذا السحر؟
scenes.image_prompt: A dramatic wide angle view of an ancient Cairo rooftop surrounded by dark glowing shadows and magical smoke, with a female cute cartoon cat wearing a blue scarf looking up bravely.
